archetype: Modern Light SaaS + Soft Mesh Gradient Glass
description: A high-precision modern SaaS foundation (crisp white, light slate-stone backdrop #F8FAFC / #F6F8FB, hairline borders 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.08), high negative space, Linear/Notion layout rigor) blended with friendly soft radial mesh gradients and crystal glassmorphism cards. Family-friendly and trustworthy without feeling childish or cartoonish. Indian rupee locale (₹1,499/quarter).

mesh_gradients.strategy: CSS-only layered radial gradients on body background and hero wrappers. Generates depth without image asset weight or heavy paint.
mesh_gradients.hero_mesh_class: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50 via-white to-slate-50/50 before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-[radial-gradient(circle_800px_at_10%_20%,rgba(37,99,235,0.07),transparent_70%)] after:absolute after:inset-0 after:bg-[radial-gradient(circle_600px_at_85%_30%,rgba(14,165,233,0.08),transparent_65%)]

motion.engine: Lenis for smooth scrolling + motion/react for layout transitions
motion.hero_load: staggered fade-up with translateY(16px) -> translateY(0px) and opacity 0 -> 1 over 500ms ease-out
motion.marquee: slow continuous smooth drift for curated publishers/curators using react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframes (duration: 35s)
motion.micro_interactions: hover:scale-[1.02] on book cards; active:scale-[0.98] on buttons; smooth pulse for due date urgency indicator

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 for body and captions against all solid & glass surfaces; 3:1 for large display titles)
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion queries; Lenis auto-disabled when user prefers reduced motion
accessibility.aria: All form controls, modals, tabs, and bundle dock actions have appropriate aria-label and role attributes
accessibility.data_testids: Every button, input, navigation link, tab, filter, and notification MUST carry a strict kebab-case role-based data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Set --font-heading: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif; and --font-sans: 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; in frontend/src/index.css.
Replace warm cream/terracotta/poppins colors with the modern crisp SaaS palette (#F8FAFC page, #FFFFFF cards, #2563EB accent, #0F172A text).
Use backdrop-filter blur-md with semi-transparent white fills (rgba(255,255,255,0.8)) and 1px crisp borders (border-slate-200/80) for cards.
Keep ALL existing routes, functionality, Pincode availability logic, 4-book bundle dock behavior, WhatsApp logs, milestone badges, and test credentials intact.
Ensure every interactive element keeps or implements data-testid attributes for testing subagent verification.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts with zero hierarchy. Use asymmetry and generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-8).
Never apply universal 'transition: all' in CSS. Specify transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-shadow.
Ensure high contrast on hover states. Whenever a button or card background changes on hover, declare explicit text color.
All toasts must use Sonner via Toaster in frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
